activities.name: Shattered Glass

activities.name: Lore Master

activities.name: Snare damage

activities.name: Spike damage
activities.text: On a failed save (see the trap).

activities.name: Smoke

activities.name: Pit damage

activities.name: Great jaw trap damage
activities.text: On a failed save (see the trap).
